name: Spectacle (Startup Videos)

sources.title: Homepage — 'The best startup and product videos, hand-picked'; curated library of marketing/brand/launch films, active (2026 videos incl. OpenAI, HubSpot, Framer)
Submit / Add a Video — gated by login: email+password or 'Continue with Google'; signup at /auth/signup?redirectTo=/submit

conditions: Requires a free account (email or Google sign-in) before the Add a Video form is accessible
The library is hand-picked — submission is subject to curation; only videos meeting the site's quality bar get in
requirements: You need a VIDEO — this is a curated library of startup/product marketing, brand, and launch films, not a product listing
Videos are tagged by production style (live action, animation, screencast, mixed media), length, mood, and industry
Fit: launch films, product explainers, brand videos — the kind 'worth studying'
preparation: A finished product/launch video (hosted URL, e.g. YouTube/Vimeo)
Likely metadata: title, brand/company name, production style, industry, mood tags
Studio credit if a production studio made it (there's a separate Featured Studios section)
workflow: Create an account at https://spectacle.is/auth/signup?redirectTo=/submit (Google or email)
Open /submit ('Add a Video') and enter the video URL plus metadata
Submission is curated — accepted videos appear in Latest Videos and relevant category/collection pages
watchFor: Requires a polished video asset — without one, this destination is unusable
Curation bar is high (the library features OpenAI, Apple, PostHog-grade work); a low-effort screen recording will likely be rejected
Site is made by video studio Thinkmojo — the directory also funnels work to featured studios
A video listing links to the video, not necessarily a product page — value is showcase/inspiration traffic
countsAsLive: The submitted video appears in the Latest Videos feed and is playable from its spectacle.is detail page
unknowns: Whether acceptance criteria or turnaround are stated post-login
Whether the listing links out to the product site as dofollow
Whether a 'Sponsor' route offers paid placement
